page_note: 本页为《2024 State of the U.S. Semiconductor Industry》第23页，主体是文字段落加一幅无编号的面积图「GLOBAL SEMICONDUCTOR SALES ($B)」，展示'01至'24E全球半导体销售额并含红色虚线预测段与框注标签。

components.evidence: dark blue box reading "-8.2% '22/'23" drawn over the filled area near '23
horizontal rules at 100..700 across the plot; no vertical grid lines
red dashed segment from '23 to a red dot at '24E, distinct from the solid blue line
pale lilac vertical band filling the '23-'24E slot marking the forecast window
title "GLOBAL SEMICONDUCTOR SALES ($B)"; y axis shows bare 0-700
the "-8.2% '22/'23" label sits inside the filled area, not outside it

new_components.name: forecast_point_marker
new_components.evidence: single red dot at '24E terminating the dashed projection above the solid area line
new_components.why_it_matters: 末端预测点与历史实线属不同数据性质，读值时需分辨该点（约611）不是实测面积线的延续。

new_components.name: area_fill_under_line
new_components.evidence: solid blue line with light purple fill down to the zero baseline across all years
new_components.why_it_matters: 填充区顶边即数值线，读值须对准顶边而非填充中部，否则误差可达数十$B。

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数值标签，唯一印出的数字是注释框里的“-8.2% '22/'23”，10个待核值全部要从像素读。y轴刻度间隔100 $B，而5%容差在'19的412上只有约20 $B，即约刻度间距的1/5、在150 dpi下不到10像素；再加上面积填充使线顶边与填充边界难以区分，'19（412）与'20（440）相差仅28 $B，两者极易互换。相比之下行标签很简单：只需“标题+年份”两个键即可唯一定位，故读值是主要瓶颈。
